definitions.explanation: Instruments or devices used in warfare. Covers a broad range from conventional arms to weapons of mass destruction. A formal, military-oriented term.

examples.japanese: {核|かく}{兵器|へいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{廃絶|はいぜつ}→廃絶：28187_haizetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{兵器|へいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧な⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: An enormous budget is being spent on weapons development.

examples.japanese: {生物|せいぶつ}{兵器|へいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国際法|こくさいほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The use of biological weapons is prohibited under international law.

notes:
A formal term used primarily in military, political, and news contexts. Different from the homophone ⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧ (calm, unconcerned).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {核|かく}{兵器|へいき} (nuclear weapons)
- {生物|せいぶつ}{兵器|へいき} (biological weapons)
- {化学|かがく}{兵器|へいき} (chemical weapons)
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧{兵器|へいき} (weapons of mass destruction)
- {兵器|へいき}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧ (arms factory)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {兵器|へいき}: weapons/arms (military context, formal)
- ⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧: weapon (broader usage, including figurative — also used in games, everyday speech)
- ⟦{凶器|きょうき}→凶器：16384_kyouki⟧: weapon used in a crime (legal/criminal context)

cross_references.notes: 平気 (へいき) means calm, unconcerned — same reading, different meaning
